easy: In a way that shows you feel worried or scared.

ex.en: She waited nervously for her name to be called.
ex.ko: 그녀는 이름이 불리기를 초조하게 기다렸다.

easy: To weigh more than something else.

ex.en: The big dog outweighs the little cat.
ex.ko: 큰 개는 작은 고양이보다 무겁다.

easy: To be more important or stronger than something else.

ex.en: The fun of the trip outweighs the long drive.
ex.ko: 여행의 즐거움이 긴 운전 시간보다 더 크다.

easy: Having to do with tiny living things that live on another animal and make it sick.

ex.en: A parasitic worm can make a dog sick.
ex.ko: 기생충이 개를 아프게 할 수 있다.

easy: A green plant with small curly leaves that people use in cooking.

ex.en: Mom grows parsley in a pot on the window.
ex.ko: 엄마는 창가 화분에 파슬리를 키우신다.

easy: Small green leaves that are put on food to make it look nice and taste good.

ex.en: The chef put parsley on top of my soup.
ex.ko: 요리사가 내 수프 위에 파슬리를 얹어 주었다.

easy: A weight that hangs from a string or rod and swings back and forth.

ex.en: The pendulum in the old clock swings back and forth.
ex.ko: 오래된 시계의 추가 앞뒤로 흔들린다.

easy: Making you feel sad deep in your heart.

ex.en: The sad movie had a poignant ending.
ex.ko: 그 슬픈 영화는 가슴 아픈 결말로 끝났다.

easy: A serious sickness that can make people unable to move their arms or legs. A shot keeps kids safe from it.

ex.en: Doctors give kids a shot so they never get polio.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님은 아이들이 소아마비에 걸리지 않도록 주사를 놓아 준다.

easy: Not safe or steady, and likely to go wrong.

ex.en: Their friendship felt precarious after the big fight.
ex.ko: 큰 싸움 뒤에 그들의 우정은 위태로워 보였다.

easy: Full of danger.

ex.en: The cat sat in a precarious spot on the edge of the roof.
ex.ko: 고양이는 지붕 끝 위태로운 곳에 앉아 있었다.

easy: A made-up reason you give to hide the real reason.

ex.en: He used a stomachache as a pretext to skip school.
ex.ko: 그는 학교에 안 가려고 배탈을 핑계로 댔다.

easy: To say in an official way that someone or something is a certain thing.

ex.en: The judges proclaimed her the winner of the spelling bee.
ex.ko: 심사위원들은 그녀를 철자 대회 우승자로 선언했다.

easy: To say something loudly and clearly so everyone hears it.

ex.en: 'I am hungry!' he proclaimed to the whole class.
ex.ko: '나 배고파!' 하고 그는 반 전체에 크게 말했다.

easy: Old-fashioned and a little odd in a nice, charming way.

ex.en: We stayed in a quaint little house by the sea.
ex.ko: 우리는 바닷가의 예스럽고 아담한 집에서 묵었다.

easy: Very strange or unusual.

ex.en: Grandpa's quaint hat had a feather and a tiny bell.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 별난 모자에는 깃털과 작은 방울이 달려 있었다.

easy: A small gray animal with a black mask on its face and a ringed tail. It comes out at night.

ex.en: A raccoon got into our trash can last night.
ex.ko: 어젯밤 라쿤이 우리 쓰레기통을 뒤졌다.

easy: Kind words or actions that make someone feel less worried.

ex.en: Dad's hug gave me reassurance before the test.
ex.ko: 아빠의 포옹이 시험 전에 나를 안심시켜 주었다.

easy: To keep someone or something from moving freely.

ex.en: Dad held the puppy back to restrain it from running into the road.
ex.ko: 아빠는 강아지가 길로 뛰어들지 못하게 붙잡았다.

easy: In a way that is more than enough.

ex.en: Our hard work was richly rewarded.
ex.ko: 우리의 노력은 충분히 보상받았다.

easy: In a fancy way, with lots of money and nice things.

ex.en: The king lived richly in a huge castle.
ex.ko: 왕은 커다란 성에서 호화롭게 살았다.

easy: A person who puts money away to keep for later.

ex.en: My sister is a good saver, and her piggy bank is full.
ex.ko: 우리 누나는 저축을 잘해서 돼지 저금통이 가득 찼다.

easy: Hurt deeply inside by something bad that happened.

ex.en: The scary storm left him scarred and afraid of thunder.
ex.ko: 무서운 폭풍 때문에 그는 마음에 상처를 입어 천둥을 무서워하게 되었다.

easy: Having marks from being hit or used a lot.

ex.en: The old desk was scarred with scratches and pen marks.
ex.ko: 낡은 책상은 긁힌 자국과 펜 자국으로 흠집투성이였다.

easy: Calm and not upset, even when things are hard.

ex.en: Mom stayed serene even when the baby cried.
ex.ko: 아기가 울어도 엄마는 침착했다.

easy: Clear, bright, and peaceful.

ex.en: We looked out at the serene blue lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 고요하고 맑은 푸른 호수를 바라보았다.

easy: The ten years from 1970 to 1979.

ex.en: My grandparents were teenagers in the seventies.
ex.ko: 우리 조부모님은 1970년대에 십대였다.

easy: The ages from 70 to 79 in a person's life.

ex.en: Grandpa is in his seventies, but he still walks every day.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 70대이지만 매일 걸으신다.

easy: Covered from the sun, so it is cooler there.

ex.en: We ate lunch on a shaded bench under the tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 나무 아래 그늘진 벤치에서 점심을 먹었다.

easy: Drawn with darker and lighter parts so it looks real.

ex.en: I drew a shaded circle so it looks like a ball.
ex.ko: 나는 공처럼 보이도록 명암을 넣은 동그라미를 그렸다.

easy: A place where workers build or fix big ships.

ex.en: Workers build huge ships at the shipyard.
ex.ko: 일꾼들은 조선소에서 커다란 배를 만든다.

easy: To cook food in liquid that is almost boiling, with tiny bubbles.

ex.en: Mom let the soup simmer for an hour.
ex.ko: 엄마는 수프를 한 시간 동안 뭉근히 끓이셨다.

easy: To make something go straight, not bent or curved.

ex.en: I straightened my bent paper clip.
ex.ko: 나는 구부러진 클립을 곧게 폈다.

easy: To make something straight.

ex.en: Please straighten your back when you sit.
ex.ko: 앉을 때는 등을 곧게 펴렴.

easy: Made simpler and faster by taking away what is not needed.

ex.en: Our streamlined morning routine gets us to school on time.
ex.ko: 간소화한 아침 일과 덕분에 우리는 제시간에 학교에 간다.

easy: A tube with a needle that doctors use to put medicine in your body or take blood out.

ex.en: The nurse filled the syringe with medicine.
ex.ko: 간호사는 주사기에 약을 채웠다.

easy: A big bag for carrying things.

ex.en: I put my library books in a tote bag.
ex.ko: 나는 도서관 책을 큰 가방에 넣었다.

easy: To carry something heavy with a lot of effort.

ex.en: I had to tote my heavy backpack up the stairs.
ex.ko: 나는 무거운 배낭을 낑낑대며 계단 위로 날라야 했다.

easy: Going across from one side to the other.

ex.en: We drew a transverse line across the page.
ex.ko: 우리는 종이를 가로질러 선을 하나 그렸다.

easy: A long spear with three sharp points at the end.

ex.en: The sea king in the story held a golden trident.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 바다의 왕은 금빛 삼지창을 들고 있었다.

easy: To pinch something quickly and sharply.

ex.en: Grandma tweaked my cheek and smiled.
ex.ko: 할머니는 내 볼을 살짝 꼬집으며 웃으셨다.

easy: To pull something sharply to take it off or out.

ex.en: He tweaked a weed out of the garden.
ex.ko: 그는 정원에서 잡초를 홱 뽑았다.

easy: When people do something in exactly the same way.

ex.en: The band marched in unison.
ex.ko: 악단은 발을 맞춰 일제히 행진했다.

easy: When people do something together at the same time.

ex.en: The whole class answered in unison.
ex.ko: 반 아이들 모두가 한목소리로 대답했다.

easy: Not ready for something.

ex.en: I felt unprepared for the math quiz.
ex.ko: 나는 수학 퀴즈 준비가 안 된 것 같았다.

easy: Having no limits or rules to stop you.

ex.en: We had unrestricted time to play at the park.
ex.ko: 우리는 공원에서 시간 제한 없이 놀 수 있었다.

easy: Free to do things without rules holding you back.

ex.en: At camp we had unrestricted access to the pool.
ex.ko: 캠프에서 우리는 수영장을 자유롭게 이용할 수 있었다.

easy: Not right or good for a certain job.

ex.en: Sandals are unsuitable for hiking in snow.
ex.ko: 샌들은 눈길 등산에 적합하지 않다.

easy: So strange or bad that you cannot even imagine it.

ex.en: Losing my dog was unthinkable to me.
ex.ko: 내 강아지를 잃는다는 건 상상도 할 수 없는 일이었다.

easy: To make someone feel happy and hopeful.

ex.en: A funny song can uplift everyone in the car.
ex.ko: 웃긴 노래는 차에 탄 모두의 기분을 북돋워 준다.

easy: When something suddenly disappears and no one knows why.

ex.en: The vanishing of the cookies surprised everyone.
ex.ko: 쿠키가 사라진 일은 모두를 놀라게 했다.

easy: When something suddenly goes out of sight.

ex.en: We watched the vanishing of the sun behind the hills.
ex.ko: 우리는 해가 언덕 뒤로 사라지는 모습을 지켜보았다.

easy: Treated with respect because it is very old and wise.

ex.en: The venerable old teacher had long white hair.
ex.ko: 존경받는 연로하신 선생님은 흰 머리가 길었다.

easy: To make a picture of something in your mind.

ex.en: Close your eyes and visualize your dream room.
ex.ko: 눈을 감고 꿈의 방을 머릿속에 그려 보렴.

easy: Using more time, work, or things than you need.

ex.en: Doing the same job twice is wasteful.
ex.ko: 같은 일을 두 번 하는 것은 비효율적이다.

easy: Using too much and throwing good things away.

ex.en: It is wasteful to throw away food that is still good.
ex.ko: 아직 먹을 수 있는 음식을 버리는 것은 낭비다.

easy: Smart to do; a good idea.

ex.en: It is advisable to wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
ex.ko: 자전거를 탈 때는 헬멧을 쓰는 것이 바람직하다.

easy: Having to do with Algeria, a country in Africa, or its people.

ex.en: We ate Algerian food at a friend's house.
ex.ko: 우리는 친구 집에서 알제리 음식을 먹었다.

easy: A person who comes from Algeria, a country in Africa.

ex.en: My neighbor is an Algerian who loves soccer.
ex.ko: 우리 이웃은 축구를 좋아하는 알제리 사람이다.

easy: Not caring about or being excited by anything.

ex.en: Her apathy about the game made the coach sad.
ex.ko: 경기에 대한 그녀의 무관심은 코치를 슬프게 했다.

easy: Not being interested in things in general.

ex.en: He showed apathy about chores and never helped.
ex.ko: 그는 집안일에 무관심해서 전혀 돕지 않았다.

easy: Something many people suddenly start liking or doing.

ex.en: When everyone liked the game, I jumped on the bandwagon too.
ex.ko: 모두가 그 게임을 좋아하자 나도 유행을 따랐다.

easy: In golf, finishing a hole with one less hit than expected.

ex.en: Dad scored a birdie on the last hole.
ex.ko: 아빠는 마지막 홀에서 버디를 기록하셨다.

easy: Made to stop believing old things and to believe new things by force.

ex.en: The brainwashed workers in the movie obeyed every order.
ex.ko: 영화 속 세뇌된 일꾼들은 모든 명령에 따랐다.

easy: A soft flat bread wrapped around food like beans, meat, and cheese.

ex.en: I had a bean and cheese burrito for lunch.
ex.ko: 나는 점심으로 콩과 치즈가 든 부리토를 먹었다.

easy: A person who stays outdoors in a tent for fun.

ex.en: Every camper got a flashlight.
ex.ko: 야영객은 모두 손전등을 하나씩 받았다.

easy: A big car or van with beds and a kitchen for sleeping on trips.

ex.en: We slept in a camper by the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 호숫가의 캠핑카에서 잤다.

easy: A small, pretty box for keeping jewelry.

ex.en: She kept her rings in a small casket.
ex.ko: 그녀는 반지를 작은 보석함에 보관했다.

easy: Keeping yourself and things neat and free of dirt.

ex.en: Cleanliness means washing your hands before you eat.
ex.ko: 청결이란 먹기 전에 손을 씻는 것이다.

easy: Working hard to keep things clean.

ex.en: Mom's cleanliness makes our house sparkle.
ex.ko: 엄마가 깔끔하게 해 두셔서 우리 집은 반짝반짝하다.

easy: To make something harder to understand or do.

ex.en: Adding more rules will complicate the game.
ex.ko: 규칙을 더 넣으면 게임이 복잡해질 것이다.

easy: A long piece of music for one player and a whole group of musicians.

ex.en: She played a piano concerto with the school orchestra.
ex.ko: 그녀는 학교 오케스트라와 피아노 협주곡을 연주했다.

easy: Happening during the same time.

ex.en: The two games were played concurrently on different fields.
ex.ko: 두 경기는 서로 다른 운동장에서 동시에 열렸다.

easy: Curved outward, like the outside of a ball.

ex.en: The back of a spoon is convex.
ex.ko: 숟가락의 뒷면은 볼록하다.

easy: The very best part at the end of something.

ex.en: Winning the trophy was the culmination of a year of practice.
ex.ko: 우승은 일 년 동안 연습한 것의 절정이었다.

easy: Cold and wet in an unpleasant way.

ex.en: The cave was dank and smelled like wet rocks.
ex.ko: 동굴은 눅눅하고 젖은 바위 냄새가 났다.

easy: When something dead or old breaks down into tiny pieces and rots.

ex.en: Decomposition turns fallen leaves into soil.
ex.ko: 분해 작용으로 떨어진 낙엽이 흙이 된다.

easy: Having lost too much water from your body.

ex.en: I felt dehydrated after soccer, so I drank water.
ex.ko: 축구를 하고 나니 탈수 증상이 와서 물을 마셨다.

easy: Harm or loss.

ex.en: Too much candy is a detriment to your teeth.
ex.ko: 사탕을 너무 많이 먹는 것은 치아에 해가 된다.

easy: Making you feel sad and gloomy.

ex.en: It was a dismal rainy day, so we stayed in.
ex.ko: 비 오는 우울한 날이어서 우리는 집에 있었다.

easy: A sad, worried feeling when things go wrong.

ex.en: To my dismay, my ice cream fell on the ground.
ex.ko: 내 아이스크림이 땅에 떨어져서 나는 낙담했다.

easy: Very different from each other.

ex.en: The two brothers have disparate hobbies: one paints and one runs.
ex.ko: 두 형제의 취미는 전혀 달라서 한 명은 그림을 그리고 한 명은 달린다.

easy: Made up of parts that are very unlike each other.

ex.en: Our class is a disparate group of kids from many places.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 여러 곳에서 온 서로 다른 아이들로 이루어져 있다.

easy: A worker who puts in or fixes electric wires and lights.

ex.en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
ex.ko: 전기 기사님이 우리 부엌의 고장 난 전등을 고쳐 주셨다.

easy: To cross out or take out words so they are gone.

ex.en: The teacher excised the extra words from my story.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내 이야기에서 불필요한 단어들을 지우셨다.

easy: To make someone leave a place by force.

ex.en: The referee expelled the player from the game.
ex.ko: 심판은 그 선수를 경기에서 퇴장시켰다.

easy: To make someone give up a job or a place.

ex.en: The club voted to expel the cheater.
ex.ko: 동아리는 투표로 반칙한 아이를 내보내기로 했다.

easy: Describes a young bird that has grown all its feathers.

ex.en: The fledged chick flew out of the nest.
ex.ko: 깃털이 다 난 새끼 새가 둥지 밖으로 날아갔다.

easy: With a lot of power.

ex.en: He kicked the ball forcefully into the net.
ex.ko: 그는 공을 힘껏 차서 골망에 넣었다.

easy: The part of a picture that looks closest to you.

ex.en: In my drawing, a dog is in the foreground.
ex.ko: 내 그림에서는 개가 앞쪽에 있다.

easy: A look on your face when you are unhappy or cross.

ex.en: Dad's frown told me I was in trouble.
ex.ko: 아빠의 찡그린 얼굴을 보고 내가 혼나게 될 걸 알았다.

easy: To pull your eyebrows together because you are unhappy or cross.

ex.en: She frowned when she saw the messy room.
ex.ko: 그녀는 어질러진 방을 보고 눈살을 찌푸렸다.

easy: Tasting or smelling like fruit.

ex.en: This juice smells fruity.
ex.ko: 이 주스는 과일 향이 난다.

easy: Showing deep love and respect for God.

ex.en: My godly grandma prays every night.
ex.ko: 신앙심 깊은 우리 할머니는 매일 밤 기도하신다.

easy: Learning the basic things you need to know about a subject.

ex.en: Good grounding in reading helps you in every subject.
ex.ko: 읽기 기초를 잘 다지면 모든 과목에 도움이 된다.

easy: Joining electric machines to the earth so they are safe.

ex.en: Grounding keeps electric machines safe.
ex.ko: 접지는 전기 기계를 안전하게 지켜 준다.

easy: A big basket, often with a lid.

ex.en: I put my dirty socks in the hamper.
ex.ko: 나는 더러운 양말을 빨래 바구니에 넣었다.

easy: Came out of an egg.

ex.en: The hatched chicks followed the mother hen.
ex.ko: 부화한 병아리들이 어미 닭을 따라갔다.

easy: Shaded with many thin lines.

ex.en: I drew a hatched picture with fine lines.
ex.ko: 나는 가는 선으로 빗금을 친 그림을 그렸다.

easy: Great courage when facing danger.

ex.en: The firefighter got a medal for her heroism.
ex.ko: 그 소방관은 영웅적인 행동으로 메달을 받았다.

easy: Arranged in levels, from the top to the bottom.

ex.en: An army is hierarchical, with a general at the top.
ex.ko: 군대는 맨 위에 장군이 있는 계급 구조다.

easy: A long, loud cry.

ex.en: We heard the howling of wolves at night.
ex.ko: 우리는 밤에 늑대의 울부짖음을 들었다.

easy: Having to do with Iceland, a country in Europe, or its people.

ex.en: We saw Icelandic horses in a photo book.
ex.ko: 우리는 사진책에서 아이슬란드 말을 보았다.

easy: The language that people speak in Iceland.

ex.en: My friend is learning Icelandic.
ex.ko: 내 친구는 아이슬란드어를 배우고 있다.

easy: A special skill for doing something well.

ex.en: My brother has a knack for drawing cartoons.
ex.ko: 우리 오빠는 만화를 그리는 재주가 있다.

easy: Food that follows Jewish rules for what people may eat.

ex.en: The store sells kosher bread.
ex.ko: 그 가게는 코셔 빵을 판다.

easy: To make something allowed by the law.

ex.en: The city legalized skateboarding in the park.
ex.ko: 시는 공원에서 스케이트보드 타는 것을 합법화했다.

easy: A very long skirt that reaches down to the ankles.

ex.en: She wore a blue maxi to the party.
ex.ko: 그녀는 파티에 파란 맥시스커트를 입고 갔다.

easy: To sit quietly and think very deeply for a long time.

ex.en: Mom meditates for ten minutes each morning.
ex.ko: 엄마는 매일 아침 10분씩 명상하신다.

easy: Studying tiny things with a special tool that makes them look big.

ex.en: Microscopy lets scientists see tiny cells.
ex.ko: 현미경 검사로 과학자들은 아주 작은 세포를 볼 수 있다.

easy: Creepy because it has to do with death and rotting.

ex.en: The haunted house had morbid decorations like old bones.
ex.ko: 귀신의 집에는 낡은 뼈 같은 섬뜩한 장식이 있었다.

easy: In a way that is hard to understand, as if keeping a secret.

ex.en: My sister smiled and said mysteriously, 'You will see.'
ex.ko: 누나는 웃으며 수수께끼처럼 '곧 알게 될 거야.'라고 말했다.

easy: Having to do with an orchestra, a big group of musicians.

ex.en: I love orchestral music with violins and drums.
ex.ko: 나는 바이올린과 북이 나오는 오케스트라 음악이 좋다.

easy: A short time when power or the internet stops working.

ex.en: A storm caused a power outage at our school.
ex.ko: 폭풍 때문에 우리 학교가 정전되었다.

easy: On your father's side of the family.

ex.en: My paternal grandparents live in Seoul.
ex.ko: 우리 친할머니와 친할아버지는 서울에 사신다.

easy: Acting like a father, kind and caring.

ex.en: He gave the lost boy a paternal pat on the shoulder.
ex.ko: 그는 길 잃은 아이의 어깨를 아버지처럼 토닥여 주었다.

easy: Thinking so hard about something that you do not notice other things.

ex.en: Mia was preoccupied with her puzzle and missed the bell.
ex.ko: 미아는 퍼즐에 푹 빠져서 종소리를 못 들었다.

easy: Having to do with Prussia, an old country in Europe that is now part of Germany.

ex.en: We read about Prussian soldiers in our history book.
ex.ko: 우리는 역사책에서 프로이센 군인들에 대해 읽었다.

easy: A person who comes from Prussia, an old country in Europe.

ex.en: The hero of the story was a Prussian who loved music.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 영웅은 음악을 좋아하는 프로이센 사람이었다.

easy: A place built along the water where boats stop.

ex.en: We waited on the quay for the ferry.
ex.ko: 우리는 부두에서 배를 기다렸다.

easy: A bar along stairs or a balcony that you hold so you do not fall.

ex.en: Hold the railing when you go down the stairs.
ex.ko: 계단을 내려갈 때는 난간을 잡으렴.

easy: A person who sees things as they truly are.

ex.en: Dad is a realist: he knows we cannot buy everything.
ex.ko: 아빠는 현실주의자라서 우리가 모든 걸 살 수는 없다는 걸 아신다.

easy: A worker at a desk who answers the phone and greets visitors.

ex.en: The receptionist at the clinic gave me a sticker.
ex.ko: 병원 접수 직원이 내게 스티커를 주었다.

easy: A person whose job is to find people to join a team or a company.

ex.en: The recruiter found new players for the team.
ex.ko: 모집 담당자가 팀에 들어올 새 선수들을 찾아냈다.

easy: An officer whose job is to sign up people for the army.

ex.en: A recruiter talked to the older students about joining the army.
ex.ko: 모병관이 상급생들에게 군대 입대에 대해 이야기해 주었다.
